checks: A real preference-save pointer gesture initializes one native Web Audio context
Pausing during the final countdown preserves milliseconds and stops sound scheduling
The deadline-based 5–1 sequence schedules five distinct beeps and one two-tone completion without duplicates after resume
Sound and timer repainting leave workout values and journal records unchanged
Muted preferences create no audio context or oscillator while the visual countdown still completes
A simulated background expiry returns to the completed state without replaying missed sounds
Dismissing the timer cancels subsequent sound events
scope: Actual Web Audio oscillator scheduling and trusted CDP pointer gestures in Chromium; pause/resume, mute and simulated visibility changes. No physical speaker, locked-phone or background-OS certification.
